summary: Iteration 51 — Validated (1) Hours CSV multi-format date parser and (2) new Bulk Import RSVPs from CSV admin endpoint + EventDetail UI dialog. All 22 backend tests passed and all frontend testids render with correct behaviour.

backend.TestHoursCsvDateParser: 7/7 passed — ISO, MM/DD/YYYY (Excel default), M/D/YY, MM-DD-YYYY, DD-Mmm-YYYY all parse; unparseable + empty date both surface error message listing 'YYYY-MM-DD, MM/DD/YYYY, M/D/YY, 15-Jun-2026'.
backend.TestAdminRsvpCsvTemplate: 2/2 passed — GET /events/{id}/admin-rsvp/csv/template returns text/csv with header 'member_email,ticket_type,guests,guest_ticket_types' + 2 sample rows; non-admin gets 403.
backend.TestAdminRsvpCsvDryRun: 4/4 passed — valid+invalid email mix surfaces 'No member with email …' error and ready row with guest_names=['Alex Plus-one','Pat Friend'] seats=3; dry-run does NOT modify rsvp_count; duplicate email in same file errors as 'appears more than once'; capacity overflow returns 'Not enough seats — needs 3, only 2 left'.
backend.TestAdminRsvpCsvConfirm: 1/1 passed — confirm with send_email=false persists N RSVPs with email_suppressed=true + created_by_admin + imported_from_csv set; event rsvp_count/guest_count incremented correctly; second dry-run on same file flags 'already has an RSVP' for both members.
backend.TestAdminRsvpCsvRejects: 6/6 passed — non-.csv filename 400, missing member_email column 400, zero data rows 400, >500 rows 400, umbrella parent event 400 with 'umbrella' message, cancelled event 400, paid event 400.

frontend.EventDetail admin RSVP CSV dialog: admin-rsvp-csv-btn visible next to admin-add-rsvp-btn. Opens admin-rsvp-csv-form. admin-rsvp-csv-email-toggle defaults aria-checked=true, toggles to false on click. admin-rsvp-csv-download-template visible. File picker -> auto dry-run -> admin-rsvp-csv-preview renders with admin-rsvp-csv-ready '✅ 1 ready', admin-rsvp-csv-failed '⚠ 1 error', admin-rsvp-csv-preview-table with per-row testids (row-2 READY Maya Patel + 2 guest pills 'Alex Plus-one' 'Pat Friend'; row-3 ERROR 'No member with email nonexistent_xyz@example.com'). admin-rsvp-csv-confirm-btn shows 'Confirm import (1 RSVP)'.
frontend.Hours CSV help text: Volunteer hours page → Import CSV dialog shows the new 'Date formats accepted: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-15), MM/DD/YYYY (Excel default), M/D/YY, 15-Jun-2026.' line as designed.

critical_code_review_comments: rsvps.py admin_rsvp_csv send_email=true path: when _create_rsvp_and_email_ticket is called and then patched with created_by_admin via a second update_one, there's a window where the ticket email task may snapshot the rsvp_doc BEFORE the admin attribution is patched. The attribution stamping is post-insert/post-email-task-scheduling. Not a correctness bug for the email content (admin attribution isn't in the email body), but a subtle ordering quirk worth a comment.
rsvps.py: the dry_run + send_email kwargs are query params (per problem spec). UI/docs note this clearly. Good.

rsvps.py admin_rsvp_csv lacks the same row-cap message contract as hours.py (hours uses 'max 1000 rows', rsvp uses 'max 500 rows'). Documented in detail messages, but two different magic numbers — consider a shared constant.

hours.py _DATE_FORMATS includes %d-%b-%y / %d-%b-%Y but the user-facing DATE_FORMATS_FOR_HUMANS only lists 15-Jun-2026 (4-digit year). Minor — 2-digit-year DD-MMM-YY (e.g. 15-Jun-26) parses but isn't advertised.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@clubhaven.app / Admin123! | Member: member@clubhaven.app / Member123!
seed_data_creation: Each test that needed isolation created a fresh event via POST /events and deleted it in teardown. test_confirm_no_email_persists_with_attribution creates 'TEST_confirm_*' event, imports 2 RSVPs, then deletes the event. test_capacity_overflow creates 'TEST_cap_event_*' (capacity=2). test_cancelled_event_rejected/test_paid_event_rejected also create + delete their own events.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 51 — Bulk Import RSVPs (admin) and Hours CSV multi-format date parser. The happy-path event id 3a9ee2e9-7852-4586-9b3f-a94b3da8af84 (Iter35 Test Event) is now used in several tests; if it gets deleted, replace HAPPY_EVENT_ID at the top of the file. Umbrella-rejection test discovers the umbrella event dynamically by title ('Anniversary' / '10-Year').
rca of the issue: N/A — both shipped features behave as specified.
